part: Front shock tower of the speedrun chassis, new design for the speedrun upper bulkhead
coordinate_system: Plane of the plate: x across the car (x = 0 centre line, as the bulkheads), y height above the parting face of the bulkheads, z = 0 back face (contact face on the shock tower wall of the upper bulkhead), z = thickness front face (damper side). In the coordinates of the bulkheads: x = x, y = tower_face_y - z, z = axis_z + y.
shared_parameters: cad/bulkhead/bulkhead_upper_parameters.json: mounting holes (tower_hole_x, tower_hole_h_lower, tower_hole_h_upper), contact face (tower_face_y), block in front of the wall (gear_block_h), root radius of the wall (wall_root_r). cad/bulkhead/bulkhead_lower_parameters.json: half width of the bulkheads (body_half_width), parting face (axis_z).
design: Flat plate: straight top edge, round ends around the damper holes, straight edges down to the round lobes of the camber link holes, straight bottom edge above the block in front of the wall. The damper holes are in the stock positions. The camber link holes are moved outward so that the rod ends have space beside the wall of the speedrun upper bulkhead. Edges: chamfer 0.5 on both faces; on the back face, the chamfer increases to the relief of the root radius along the bottom edge; holes with chamfers of 0.3.

source_codes.user: Measurement or information from the owner of the car
source_codes.photo: Estimate from photos of the car
source_codes.design: Design choice of the model, free

thickness.note: Carbon plate, 3 mm (owner), as the stock shock towers (3.0 mm Eco-Carbon, spec). The upper bulkhead is designed for it: screws M3x8 through the tower, 5 mm thread engagement in the wall.

hole_d.note: Through holes M3 (mounting screws M3x8, damper ball studs, camber link ball studs).

hole_chamfer.note: Chamfer of the hole edges on both faces (no sharp edges). The screw heads and the ball studs seat on the flat face around it.

stock_hole_d.note: Assumed diameter of the holes of the stock front shock tower. The measurements of the owner refer to the edges of these holes (top of the lower mounting hole, outer end of the upper mounting hole).

camber_dx.note: Stock front shock tower: centre of the camber link hole 8.5 mm outward from the top of the lower mounting hole.

camber_dy.note: Stock front shock tower: centre of the camber link hole 5 mm below the top of the lower mounting hole.

damper_dx.note: Stock front shock tower: centre of the damper hole 20.5 mm outward from the outer end of the upper mounting hole.

damper_dy.note: Stock front shock tower: centre of the damper hole 2 mm above the upper mounting hole.

rod_end_clearance_r.note: Radius around the axis of the camber link ball stud that is kept free behind the tower for the rod end (rod end approx. 7 mm plus clearance, estimate from the photos; to be measured). The rod ends sit on the back side of the tower (wall side), the dampers on the front side (photo of the car).

rod_end_depth.note: Length of the zone kept free for the rod end behind the back face of the tower (estimate).

lobe_r.note: Outer radius of the lobes around the camber link holes (edge 1.9 mm around the hole).

end_r.note: Radius of the round ends around the damper holes. The top edge is tangent to them.

bottom_gap.note: Gap between the bottom edge of the tower and the block in front of the wall (17.8 mm above the parting face).

side_gap.note: Gap between the tower and the side faces of the bulkhead where the tower reaches below the block.

inside_r.note: Radius of the inside corners of the outline (end mill 2 mm).

edge_chamfer.note: Chamfer of the outline edges on both faces, as the edge chamfers of the bulkheads.

root_clearance.note: Relief on the back face along the bottom edge: chamfer at 45 degrees with the legs root radius of the wall + 0.25 (2.25 below the top of the root radius), 0.18 mm clear of the root radius. The relief covers the width of the bulkhead and runs out to the edge chamfer over 1.5 mm.
